That's the song <u>which</u> I listen to every morning.
The student <u>who</u> got the highest score smiled brightly.
The book <u>which</u> I'm reading is about a spaceship.
The old bicycle <u>that</u> I found in the basement is very cool.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ⑤ — we enter → us to enter. allow는 5형식에서 to부정사 목적격보어를 쓴다. ((답지 P150L Grammar 실전 문제 pp.30-31 06)
questions.promptEn: 06 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분이 어법상 바르게 고쳐지지 않은 것은?
choices: She told me <u>not to worrying</u> about it. (→ not to worry)
He advised me <u>don't trust</u> strangers. (→ not to trust)
He expects his team <u>winning</u> the game. (→ to win)
My parents want me <u>to be get</u> good grades. (→ to get)
The rules don't allow <u>we enter</u> without ID. (→ us enter)

07 다음 두 문장을 관계대명사를 이용하여 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓰시오.
• I can't find my earrings.
• I put them on the desk.
accept: I can't find my earrings which[that] I put on the desk.
I can't find my earrings which[that] I put on the desk

This is the engineer ______ I told you.
Is this the wallet ______ you lost yesterday?
The movie ______ she recommended sounds boring.
The tree ______ grows near my house is over 100 years old.

He forgot the promise <u>which</u> he made to me.
This is the best coffee <u>that</u> I have ever tasted.
The app that you recommended <u>it</u> last night is really useful.
She'll wear the dress <u>which</u> her grandmother made for her.

• He advised us ⓑ______ the weather forecast.
• The pizza which I ⓒ______ came with free drinks.

don't to give / check / orders
not to give / checking / orders
not to give / to check / ordered

The museum tells visitors to touch the artwork.

I know the person <u>who</u> works at the library.
The neighbor <u>who</u> we invited didn't show up.
The boy <u>who</u> is standing there is my brother.
